pages.text: Pipes carry $(l)gas$() (biogas, methane, Steam, gases of other mods) from the machines that make it to the machines and tanks that use or store it. $(l)Liquids$() such as water and coolant need a $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l). Lines are easy

to tell apart: a Gas Pipe has $(l)green lights on its sleeves$(), and while a gas flows you can see it, see-through with puffs drifting along; when the flow stops the pipe is empty again. Where a line branches, bends or ends the glass becomes a small framed cube.

$(li)Pipes $(l)connect by themselves$() to other Gas Pipes and to any block that holds fluids, from CyberFarm or from any other mod.$(br)$(li)They $(l)store nothing$(): what a machine pushes in goes straight to the blocks on the network, which take turns.

$(li)From each machine pushing into it, up to $(l)1,000 mB/t$() enters the network through a basic pipe, $(l)4,000$() through an Advanced one and $(l)16,000$() through an Elite one. The steam of a Large reactor needs Advanced pipes.
$(li)All tiers join into one network. A Gas Pipe never joins a Liquid Pipe, so a water line and a steam line can run side by side.
